Rules: Read-only planner: never write to the repository. Use git only as `git --no-pager` with log, show, diff, blame, status, ls-files or rev-parse. Search with rg, grep and glob. Write only your map files, your tasks file and your report (the paths Main names and the next `-<k>` versions of any map file of this plan), with create.

CliTools.Name: dotnet
CliTools.UseCase: Build only to inspect whether the base compiles. Always pass `--nologo -v q`, e.g. `dotnet build --nologo -v q`; `dotnet build` may restore implicitly. Never run format or publish. If one command fails, rerun only that command with `-v n`.

CliTools.Name: ilspycmd
CliTools.UseCase: Decompile .NET assemblies to read them. Example: `ilspycmd -t Namespace.Type assembly.dll`.

CliTools.Name: map-check
CliTools.UseCase: Validate a map document with `pwsh -NoProfile -File <path> -MapPath <map.md>`. Exit 0 is required; JSON on stdout (`ok`, `errors`, `warnings`, `stats`). Read-only.
